GENERATOR AND DRIVE BELT
TSB Revision
ENGINE OVERHAUL <3.0L ENGINE>
11D-5
REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> CRANKSHAFT BOLT LOOSENING
1. Install special tool MD998781 to hold the flywheel or drive 
plate.
2. Loosen and remove the crankshaft bolt and washer.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< CRANKSHAFT BOLT TIGHTENING
1. Install special tool MD998781 to hold the flywheel or drive 
plate.
2. Install the washer and crankshaft bolt, and then tighten the 
bolt.
Tightening torque: 181 ± 5 N⋅m (134 ± 4 ft-lb)
